keyEvents.text: Goal! Charlton Athletic 0, Bolton Wanderers 1. Sam Dalby (Bolton Wanderers) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.
Harvey Knibbs (Charlton Athletic) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Charlie Kelman (Charlton Athletic).
Delay in match because of an injury Akin Famewo (Bolton Wanderers).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Charlton Athletic 0, Bolton Wanderers 1.
Substitution, Charlton Athletic. Miles Leaburn replaces Nathaniel Chalobah.
Substitution, Bolton Wanderers. Gaizka Larrazabal replaces Samuel Iling-Junior.
Substitution, Bolton Wanderers. Thierry Gale replaces Max Lott.
Substitution, Charlton Athletic. Matty Godden replaces Charlie Kelman.
Delay in match because of an injury Josh Sheehan (Bolton Wanderers).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Bolton Wanderers. Rúben Rodrigues replaces Josh Sheehan because of an injury.
Rúben Rodrigues (Bolton Wanderers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
